intro: By creating an account or using Videa, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any of these terms, do not use the platform.

user.title: User account
user.content: The user is responsible for all activities carried out through their account. It is the user's responsibility to keep their credentials secure and not share access with third parties.

posts.title: Published content
posts.content: Users may publish content such as texts, images, videos, comments, and messages. Each user is fully responsible for the content published through their account.

interaction.title: Social interactions
interaction.content: The platform allows interactions between users, including likes, comments, friend requests, and message exchanges. Users must maintain respectful behavior during these interactions.

ban.title: Prohibited use
ban.content:
• Spam or excessive message sending
• Harassment or threats
• Illegal content
• Extremely offensive content
• Attempts to exploit platform vulnerabilities
• Uploading malicious files
• Unauthorized automated use

upload.title: Media upload and storage
upload.content: Images, videos, and other files uploaded by users may be stored on services used by the platform. The user is responsible for the files they upload.

delete.title: Content removal
delete.content: Content may be removed by the platform in case of violation of these terms. Some data may remain temporarily stored for technical reasons, auditing, or system integrity.

service.title: Service availability
service.content: The service may experience temporary interruptions, maintenance, technical failures, or instability.

limitation.title: Changes to the terms
limitation.content: The Terms of Service may be updated in the future. Continued use of the platform after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
